setpiece.name: The Broken Span
setpiece.what: the bridge at the second bend is down; an ambush from the ledges above while you find the way across the fallen stones

chasm._: Owner, 2026-11-15: the way there meanders. It winds north under the ridge, back south through a slot to the Broken Span, north again round a buttress and out at the Sill; the causeway sweeps down to the drawbridge in an S (src/core/east.js WAY).

gates.name: The Drawbridge Gate
gates.note: raised at first: you go in by the West outfall and winch it down from the gatehouse, horns sounding (the second reveal). Bent, uphill passage, inner gate offset.

gates.name: The Charnel Gate
gates.note: north; a shortcut, opened from inside by the Ashwardens' line

gates.name: The Tanners' Water Gate
gates.note: south, on the Slough; a shortcut, opened from inside by the Quiet Watch's line

gates.name: The Castle Gate
gates.note: east; held by the Gate Captain (a hard wall at level 68). The Aqueduct from Apricot's garden is the way in before you can beat him.

city.unbuilt: About 40% of the ground inside the wall is not streets: the burnt fields of the Cinder Quarter, the grave rows, the parade ground, the Slough's basin, the crag's foot.
city.ring: The Guard Tower Ring: of about 78 wall towers, eight are forts you can take (a chest, a view, a chain that opens a stretch of wall-walk as a shortcut). The rest are scenery.
city.route_bones: The Corpse Quay: a towpath up the Slough's east bank from the Wharf to the Bone Yards, so the north is not a detour.
city.reacts: The city answers you: each hub's finished line turns its district (the Pennyless reopen Cinder stalls, the Quiet Watch man the Water Gate, the Ashwardens still the Bone Yards' rows), and the hubs visibly grow.
city.outfall_run: The Outfall Run: the west outfall to the Barbican's drain is its own short level-20 stretch, grated off from the West Drains proper, which open at 28.
city.dungeon_rule: Each dungeon sits a tier above its district: you clear the streets first and come back for the door.
city.towers_note: deg: 0 east, 90 north, 180 west, 270 south (z = centre z - b sin).

wall._: Owner, 2026-11-15: the city wall is a dodecagon, not a round. Twelve straight sides; the middles of the sides lie on the old oval (a, b), so a flat side is square to the drawbridge, the castle, and the north and south gates. Corners from the south-east round by the south (src/core/east.js CITY_WALL).

bosses.name: The Sexton of the High Ward

idol.name: The sacrificial idol
idol.made_with: the Librarian, cast at the Forge
idol.needs: one part from each of the eight castle dungeons; five clears a part (the owner's rule), no two alike: clear 1 is the story run, 2 to 5 each take a different route, boss order and modifier, and leave a permanent shortcut. Spare fifths (from castle world bosses and the household's quests) never shorten the five: they go to the part's second tier, which strengthens what that part opened. Every finished part opens something at once.

castle.quest_gates: Every dungeon's own door is opened by a line of the Librarian's household's quests (dozens in all); the Ossuary Chapel by the Sexton's rites.

household.what: a mage hiding his loyalty behind deception magic; the idol
the Map Room's secrets, the secret links

household.role: a lapsed sister of the Sanctuaries
household.what: the Sexton's rites, the Ossuary Chapel
the Armoury, the Forge, arming the Quiet Watch

castle.reacts: The castle answers you: horns sounded change the patrols; each key turns a ward (lamps lit, a gate left open, the household's people moving in).
castle.high_ward_note: The High Ward opens by the Sanctuaries Stair (the Archive's key, level 80) or the Crypt door (the Alchemists' key, 86); its rest point is the Sanctuaries, the first wing you reach.
castle._: Owner, 2026-11-15: far taller than first laid out (the wards were +70, +90, +115). Now +120, +175, +235 m over the plain (src/core/east.js WARDS).

keep._: Owner, 2026-11-15: the Keep is on top of the castle. Its towers rise from the High Ward's roofs; the Throne Antechambers are the foot of the first stair up. Raised 2026-11-15 on the owner's word (even taller, more towers, more bridges): the trunk to 680 m, the five spires 410 to 640 m, 16 satellites and two dozen lesser towers, all bridged (src/core/phobos-build.js SPIRES, phobosKeep). The spires' heights and places below are the first layout's and are superseded by that file until the Keep's own chunk re-lays its floors.

hub.name: The Crown Court
hub.where: the roof terrace of the High Ward at the spires' feet: the Keep's rest point (seal), reached by a lift from the Throne Antechambers; a lift comes down to it from every crossing once that crossing is won

keep.cast: The Crown Court's people: one prisoner freed on each spire's first clear stays at the Court (a smith, a healer, a scout, a herald, a jailer turned), each with quests of their own. Their quests, the Wyrm and each crossing boss give spare fifths of the part of the spire just climbed; spares never shorten the five clears, they raise that part's second tier.
keep.reacts: The Keep answers you: a spire won is lit, and its light is seen from the whole city.
keep.plan_note: In plan the five spires ring the trunk on its north, east and south sides (z from -95 to +95), so from the west they stand out to either side of it: a trunk with shoulders.

scene.beat: The pinch opens. Low camera at the hero's boots on the Sill; the moat plain, the wall, the raised drawbridge. A horn, far off.
scene.sound: a single horn; wind; the hero's breath

scene.beat: The city: the camera slides along the wall from the Barbican to the Slough's gate; smoke over the Cinder Quarter, lamps on the Mages' Rise.
scene.sound: Lisandra's voice, far off: one line naming the city; low strings begin

scene.beat: The wards: a slow climb up the Castle Approach's switchback and over the three ward walls, each higher.
scene.sound: drums under the strings as each ward wall is crossed

scene.beat: The Keep: the five spires named one by one as the camera rounds them, the Wyrm stirring on the Crown Court's roofs.
scene.sound: the choir enters; each spire's name is spoken as it is passed; the Wyrm's chains

scene.beat: The Throne Tower's top, a figure on its balcony; the camera falls all the way back to the hero. Control returns.
scene.sound: silence, then one low horn as the figure turns; the music resolves as control returns

scene_phone: On Low the scene runs on a fixed camera path with the castle and Keep swapped to their full meshes for its length only and the city held at its far level of detail; beats 3 and 4 never bring the city's streets into close view.

liveries._: Owner, 2026-11-15: Velscour's knights, necromancers, wizards and the rest are palette swaps of the existing models. Outside his area they wear various swaps; once in his area, blood red. Some castle and Keep wings have their own colour; some areas mix the schemes, the bigger boss fights above all. Swaps only (recoloured textures), no new models.

schemes.blood: blood-red armour: the default everywhere in Phobos

where.marches: the world's existing swaps, a different one at each keep

keep.crossings: mixed: each crossing boss wears two schemes

liveries.rule: Owner, 2026-11-15: royal blue and grey-with-gold are kept apart (blue beside gold is Tessariel's). Never on one figure, never side by side in one pack or one boss fight. Mixed areas pair royal with blood, bone or forest, and gilt with blood, bone or forest.

basin._: Owner, 2026-11-15: the basin the city and castle stand in is not round; its cliffs stand right up against the north and south gates (about 40 m outside the wall there) and are drawn in hard against the castle's crag north and south. The outline is src/core/east.js BASIN_N, BASIN_S; drawn in art/phobos/east/relief.jpg.
